note: νμ charged-current single-π+ to quasi-elastic cross-section ratio on mineral oil (CH2) in the Fermilab Booster Neutrino Beam (mean Eν≈0.8 GeV), reported as a function of neutrino energy over 0.4 GeV < Eν < 2.4 GeV (Aguilar-Arevalo et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 103 (2009) 081801). The paper's headline result is this dimensionless cross-section ratio, published in two forms in Table II: the observed CC1π+-like/CCQE-like ratio (measured directly, not corrected for hadronic final-state interactions in the target nucleus) and the FSI-corrected CC1π+/CCQE ratio (unfolded to the initial interaction vertex using MC, for comparison with prior ANL/K2K measurements). Both are genuine published observables and are ingested here as dimensionless ratios. The NUISANCE cc1pipccqerat_like_edit.txt / cc1pipccqerat_corr_edit.txt files reproduce Table II exactly. Target: CH2 (mineral oil). No covariance is published (per-bin total statistical+systematic uncertainty only).
